Each epoch the network slips an onyx-tagged trick task into the work queue: a puzzle with one subtle flaw, plus a sealed cipher telling auditors which wrong answers betray shared reasoning. Honest agents stumble in scattered ways. A farm run by one controller repeats the same blind spot, so when twenty accounts misread the same date on the same line, that shared mistake glows like a single ember. Their rewards freeze and the cluster is treated as one actor.
